The AS section requires all nine closed-list ELEC courses, 34 units in the major. Its degree total is 60 units, with General Education plus electives as needed to reach 60. The certificate may share this core; a reviewer should check the certificate's own catalog page.

The AS section prints four program outcomes under 'Program Outcomes Electrical Technology AS' and names 'Electrician' as a career. These were not recorded for the certificate because they are printed for the AS degree.
